summary: Preserve partially initialized exports during CommonJS require cycles.

target.notes: The module must enter the cache before its body finishes so a cycle can receive current partial exports.

semantics.cycle: unfinished cached module exports can be returned
semantics.ordering: writes before the cyclic require are observable

caveats: Do not topologically sort CommonJS modules as if they were ESM.

tests.name: cycle sees partial export
cycle eventually finishes
